formulae.name: openssl@4
formulae.caveats:
To add additional certificates, place .pem, .crt, .cer, or .crl files in
  $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/etc/openssl@4/certs

and run
  $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/Cellar/openssl@4/4.1.0/bin/openssl rehash $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/etc/openssl@4/certs
